definition: Artificial intelligence (AI) refers to computer-based systems capable of performing functions that typically require human intelligence, such as recognizing patterns, adapting from experience, or making decisions. Under 15 U.S. Code § 9401, AI is described as a machine-based system that operates toward human-defined objectives by generating predictions, recommendations, or decisions that affect real or virtual environments. The Fiscal Year 2019 National Defense Authorization Act (Pub. L. 115-232, § 238), codified in 10 U.S. Code § 4001 further defines AI to include:  Artificial systems that can act under unpredictable conditions without close human oversight, or that learn and improve performance when exposed to data.  Systems developed in software, hardware, or other contexts to perform tasks requiring human-like perception, reasoning, planning, learning, communication, or action.  Cognitive architectures and neural networks designed to replicate human thought or behavior.  Techniques such as machine learning that approximate cognitive tasks.  Rational systems, including intelligent agents or robots, that achieve goals through perception, planning, reasoning, learning, communication, and decision-making. In 2023, the EEOC, DOJ, CFPB, and FTC issued a Joint Statement on Enforcement Efforts Against Discrimination and Bias in Automated Systems, reminding businesses that automated decision-making systems remain subject to anti-discrimination and consumer protection laws, highlighting risks of algorithmic bias in areas like employment and credit. Courts have also started addressing AI’s role in legal practice. In In re Martin, 670 B.R. 636 (Bankr. N.D. Ill. 2025), lawyers were sanctioned for submitting a brief with fictitious citations generated by a large language model. The Court drew a distinction between predictive AI (which classifies or forecasts) and generative AI (which creates new content that may not always be reliable). For research and technical standards, see the National Institute of Standards and Technology’s resources on artificial intelligence.
